anatomic_site_tumor: From selected prostate cancer patients (PC; n = 3), urine samples prior to radical prostatectomy and resected prostate cancer tissue samples were collected.
disease_state: prostate cancer, benign prostate hyperplasia, urothelial cancer of the bladder, renal cell carcinoma

Mass spectrometry-based proteomic analysis of urinary EV (uEV) in men with benign and malignant prostate disease allowed us to significantly expand the known human uEV proteome with high specificity and identifies a unique biological profile in prostate cancer not uncovered by the analysis of soluble proteins.
